intro.title:
Six picks will reveal
your own Beauty DNA
intro.sub:
A Beauty Gem lights up with every choice —
and your own brand picks are waiting at the end.

core1.title: EMPTY BOTTLE CHALLENGE
core1.question: Which product would you **finish and buy again**?
core1.hint: Flip through each product's story, then drag your pick to the REPICK zone.
core1.footerNudge: Pick the one that satisfies you for long

A.name: Viral Glow Serum
A.stage1: Instant glow! Just like on SNS.
A.stage2: The magic feels a little smaller than the hype.
A.stage3: Not sure I see a real change.
A.stage4: It was pretty… but would I rebuy?

B.name: Steady Barrier Cream
B.stage2: My skin feels calmer day by day.
B.stage3: No tightness even in the afternoon. Real change.
B.stage4: A proud empty bottle. Rebuying without a doubt!

C.name: Classic Daily Lotion
C.stage1: The comfort of an old favorite. Never fails.
C.stage4: Always in my cart, no questions asked.
